messages.subject: Problem with req$POST()
parts:
Hi all,

I'm running into some issues with rApache and using the requests objects. The code works fine with the built-in Rook webserver, but the issue seems to be that I trigger a call to rewind() which isn't supported by rApacheInputStream. I AM able to access the POST global object directly, so that's working as a workaround for now, but it seems like the 'right way' is to use the Request object.

See below for reproducible example.

Thanks!
Evan

Sample request (default content-type is application/x-www-form-urlencoded, but I run into the same issue regardless of what I set the content type to):
curl -v -d 'data={"a":"blah"}' http://127.0.0.1:9293/myapp

And sample app looks like the following.

library(RJSONIO)

app <- function(env) {
    
    req <- Rook::Request$new(env)
    res <- Rook::Response$new()

    tryCatch (
      
      if (req$post()){
          data <- req$POST()[["data"]]
          jsonData <- fromJSON(data)
          res$write(toJSON(jsonData)
      },
      error = function(cond) {
        message <- c(cond)
        names(message) <- c("error")
        res$write(toJSON(message))
      },
      warning = function(cond) {
        message <- c(cond)
        names(message) <- c("warning")
        res$write(toJSON(message))
      }
    )
    res$finish()
}
